candidate_observations.address: Brislington Concourse, Bath Road, Bristol, BS4 5BQ
observed_facts: Gross income is £189,227 across 23 shops and one flat while four units are vacant.
The interest is held on two Bristol City Council leases with about 69 and 71 years remaining and total ground rent of £10,200.
Several occupancies are holding over or at will and multiple leases contain near-term break or review dates.
A 2023 feasibility study considered 96 flats and eight shops.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The feasibility study was not treated as planning permission; vacant units received no rent and the £10,200 superior ground rent was kept separate from gross occupational income.

candidate_observations.address: Holland and Barrett, 253 High Street, Bangor, LL57 1PB
observed_facts: Holland & Barrett Retail Limited, company 02758955, is active and pays £18,000.
The five-year lease began on 24 February 2026 and expires on 23 February 2031.
The tenant has an option to determine on the third anniversary.

candidate_observations.guardrail: Income was not treated as secure beyond the third-anniversary option; no guide price was inferred and peppercorn rent was not counted as income.

observed_facts: The £46,334 headline covers twelve retail units plus residential, CCTV and substation income.
